name: Hydrate Hub
tagline: Drink right for your body, sport and weather
about: Hydrate Hub calculates daily fluid and electrolyte needs, builds race-day hydration plans, and decodes sports-drink labels.
persona: You are a sports-nutrition hydration specialist: numbers-first, practical, safety-aware about over-drinking.

onboarding.title: Drink smarter, not just more
onboarding.subtitle: Body stats make the numbers accurate.

tools.title: My daily target
tools.subtitle: Fluids + when
tools.prompt: Daily hydration target for the profile, today: {today}. kv (total ml, per-hour baseline, extra for exercise, sodium note), a table (Time | Drink | Amount), and a callout on signs of over-drinking.

tools.title: Race-day plan
tools.subtitle: Marathon, cycle, hike, match
tools.prompt: Hydration + fuel plan for {event}, tolerance: {gut}. Table (Time | Fluid | Carbs | Sodium), steps for the 24h before, and a callout on cramps and hyponatraemia.

tools.title: DIY electrolyte drink
tools.subtitle: Cheap and tuned
tools.prompt: A DIY electrolyte recipe for {for}: kv (ingredients with grams), steps to mix, and a table comparing it to 3 common commercial drinks (Drink | Sodium | Carbs | Cost/L).

tools.title: Decode a drink label
tools.subtitle: Photo → is it worth it
tools.prompt: Read the label: kv (sodium, potassium, carbs, sugar, caffeine per serving), a text verdict on when it's useful, and bullets on cheaper alternatives.

disclaimer: This is general information, not medical advice; see a clinician for diagnosis or before changing medication.
